assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = $json.d; return d.kind === 'reschedule' ? `Thanks for your patience, ${d.client_first_name}. ${d.owner_name} couldn't move your call to ${d.when_label} ET, so your original time (${d.original_when_label} ET) still stands. Want me to look for another option?` : `Thanks for your patience, ${d.client_first_name}. Unfortunately ${d.when_label} ET won't work for ${d.owner_name}. Would you like me to find another time?`; })() }}

parameters.text: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Record Decision').first().json.d; const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>'); const status = { approve: '✅ Approved: calendar invite sent and client confirmed.', decline: '❌ Declined: client offered another time.', stale: '⌛ No longer pending (' + esc(d.booking_status) + '). Nothing was booked.', already_handled: 'ℹ️ Already handled (' + esc(d.previous_action) + ').', spam_brush_off: '👋 Brushed off: a polite reply was sent.', spam_ignore: '🔇 Ignored: no reply sent.', spam_not_spam: '✅ Not spam: Ava is handling it as a normal inquiry.' }[d.outcome] ?? 'Done.'; return esc(d.alert_text) + '\n\n' + status; })() }}

assignments.name: client_text
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Record Decision').first().json.d; const cal = $('Create Calendar Event').isExecuted ? $('Create Calendar Event').first().json : $('Move Calendar Event').first().json; const meet = cal.meet_link || ''; const moved = d.kind === 'reschedule'; const head = moved ? `Done, ${d.client_first_name}! Your ${d.service} with ${d.owner_name} has been moved to ${d.when_label} ET.` : `Great news, ${d.client_first_name}! Your ${d.service} with ${d.owner_name} is confirmed for ${d.when_label} ET (${d.duration_min} min).`; const how = d.call_format === 'phone' ? `${d.owner_name} will call you at ${d.call_phone}.` : (meet ? `Join on Google Meet: ${meet}` : 'The Google Meet link is in your calendar invite.'); const invite = d.client_email ? `${moved ? 'An updated' : 'A'} calendar invite is on its way to ${d.client_email}.` : ''; return [head, how, invite, 'Just reply here if anything changes.'].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n'); })() }}

additionalFields.text: ={{ ({ approve: 'Booked ✅', decline: 'Declined', stale: 'This request is no longer pending', already_handled: 'Already handled', spam_brush_off: 'Polite reply sent', spam_ignore: 'Ignored', spam_not_spam: 'Handed to Ava' })[$('Record Decision').first().json.d.outcome] ?? 'Done' }}

parameters.content:
## Owner Actions
Handles Approve / Decline taps. The database records the decision first, so a second tap or a tap on an expired request does nothing. Approve creates (or moves) the calendar event, marks the booking approved and confirms to the client. The owner alert is edited to show the outcome and its buttons are removed.

assignments.name: client_text
assignments.value: Thanks for reaching out! This isn't something we need right now, but we appreciate you thinking of us. All the best.

nodeGroups.description: Marks the booking approved with its calendar event and writes the client confirmation.

nodeGroups.description: Edits the owner alert to show the outcome, removes its buttons and acknowledges the tap.

nodeGroups.name: Record and route
nodeGroups.description: Records the tap atomically (blocks double or late taps) and routes approve, decline, or stale.
